sections.Profile:
The "Tim-Buc-Tu" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in January 1956, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1956
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Wood Rail, Card games, Original Theme
